 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Abhishek Kumar, Advocate

For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Dinesh Singh, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar Verma
Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the informant and State.

2. Petitioner seeks bail who is in custody since 14.11.2022 in connection with Raxaul P.S. Case No.
152 of 2021, F.I.R. dated 28.04.2021 for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 302, 420, 406 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. According to prosecution case, informant's minor son came in wrong association of Hanuman Sah @ Dipu Sah.
Hanuman Sah asked his minor son to commit theft of money from his house and Hanuman Sah used to take him to his house.
In due course Piyush took away huge amount of money from the informant's house and gave to Hanuman Sah and his father Krishna Sah.
On getting knowledge of the same, informant planned to inquire into the matter.

In the meantime, the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.14548 of 2023(5) dt.18-08-2023 petitioner took his son Piyush to his shop and with intention to kill with administered cold dring adulterated with poison to Piyush and left him at Kali Temple.
Piyush was admitted in ICU and on 28.04.2021 at about 4:00 pm, he died.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has clean antecedent and he has falsely Hanuman Sah @ Dipu Sah @ Dipu Kumar @ Deepu ... vs The State Of Bihar on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40296500/
1 been implicated in the present case.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that the allegation as alleged in the F.I.R. is false and fabricated and the petitioner has not committed any offence as alleged in the F.I.R.

He further submits that the informant is not the eye witness of the alleged occurrence and as per allegation in the F.I.R., the petitioner has administered poison in cold drinks to kill the son of the informant but the F.S.L. report has not supported the case of the prosecution as alleged in the F.I.R.

The police after investigation submitted charge sheet against the petitioner and the petitioner is in custody since 14.11.2022.
5.

The learned counsel for the informant as well as learned APP on the other hand vehemently opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner and submits that the petitioner has taken away the son of the informant from his house and gave illicit cold drinks administered with poison to the son of the informant and the F.S.L. report also confirms that Aluminum Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.14548 of 2023(5) dt.18-08-2023 Phosphide was detected in the cold drink.

Result of Examination:-
i. ALUMINIUM PHOSPHIDE was detected in the contents of all twelve plastic containers marked '1' to '12' as described above.
Aluminium Phosphide is commercially known as 'CELPHOS' is a severe gastro intestine irritant.
It is used as grain preservative and is highly poisonous.
ii. Poison and other Alkaloid could not be detected in the contents of plastic container marked '13' as described above.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and the report of the F.S.L, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail in connection with Raxaul P.S. Case No. 152 of 2021 pending in the court of learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Raxaul, Motihari, East Champaran.

entities.text: Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Raxaul, Motihari, East Champaran
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 7. Prayer is refused.

(Rajesh Kumar Verma, J)
